name: @nvhash/db-indexed
description: Read-only Prisma client over the `indexed` schema for services/api (app plan PR 3.1, ADR-001 Decision 1). Generated from the indexer's canonical schema (services/indexer/prisma) — this package holds NO schema copy and runs NO migrations; read-only is enforced by the SELECT-only `api_reader` database role (roles.sql + the grant-boundary CI gate), never by the client.
